messages:
maya: Heads-up — planning to enable lumen-6b-v3 in the catalog for HOSTED and DEDICATED today during the 18:00 UTC change window.

sam: +1. What fallback ordering are we using? new quant variant or older lumen-6b-v2?

maya: Priority ladder: lumen-6b-v3 (primary), lumen-6b-v3-quant (degen), lumen-6b-v2 (legacy). If v3-quant fails QoS, we fall back to v2.

jordan: Ops note: for Dedicated customers on pins we need an explicit pinbackstop. If a tenant has lumen-6b-v2 pinned, do not override.

maya: Correct — pin precedence remains. This rollout only affects unpinned catalog routing.

deploybot: Preflight checks starting: model artifacts checksum OK, quant profile present, latency baseline available.

ops-alert-bot: rolling checks: infra capacity OK in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. light pressure in ap-southeast-1 (10% headroom).

lee: Can we add a short rollback trigger set? e.g. if p50 > 250ms or error-rate spike > 1% for 5m then auto-roll to lumen-6b-v2 and alert.

maya: Yes. Proposed automated rollback thresholds: p50 >= 250ms OR request_errors_ratio >= 1.0% sustained for 5min OR decoder-exceptions > 0.2% for 10min. Deploybot will execute fallback ladder on trigger.

sam: Add a manual hold step for EU change window — want a 5-min observation before global ramp.

maya: Done. Canary window: 10% traffic for 15 min -> observe metrics -> 30% -> 60% -> full. EU pause at 10% for manual ack.

deploybot: canary start command: `deploybot enable-model --model lumen-6b-v3 --env hosted,dedicated --canary 10 --stages 10,30,60 --eu-pause true`

jordan: Release notes snippet for console: "lumen-6b-v3: improved throughput and prompt-stability; fallback ordering updated to prefer quantized variant before legacy v2."

lee: Quick test: will we run synthetic prompt set A/B to compare quality regressions? Put evals under /datasets/lumen-rollout/quickset.

maya: Yes running evals concurrently — if quality delta (win-rate) drops > 2% vs v2 we abort.

deploybot: Canary started at 1751234600. Telemetry links: https://console.redwood/test/rollouts/1751234567

sam: Watching the graphs. small latency bump but within thresholds. no error spike yet.

ops-alert-bot: Observable: p50 = 198ms, p95 = 420ms, errors = 0.12% over last 5m.

jordan: Good. Reminder: pinbackstop for Dedicated customers updated in catalog policy (docs PR #482).

maya: If anything unexpected, tag @eng-releases and run `deploybot rollback --model lumen-6b-v3 --to lumen-6b-v2 --reason "manual"`. Keep comms here. :thumbsup:
